plan.goal: Explore and critique the UX of the privacy-dashboard, focusing on the primary privacy settings flow, adjacent states (modals, toggles), and recovery paths, across desktop and mobile viewports.
plan.summary: Start with the index.html dashboard, validate core controls (toggles, modals, buttons) in desktop view. Then repeat critical checks (delete modals, export) in mobile view. Prioritize high-risk actions (delete account, export) and small tap targets identified in prescan.
assumptions: Small tap targets (≤44px) may cause mobile UX issues
risk_hotspots: Small tap targets (e.g., top navigation links <44px height)

phases.title: Desktop: Core Dashboard Controls
phases.objective: Validate primary dashboard interactions (toggles, modals, navigation) in desktop view.
key_checks: Test 'Delete my X data' (e.g., activity) → check double-confirmation
Validate small tap targets (e.g., top nav links) → check usability
exit_criteria: All core dashboard controls tested (toggles, modals, buttons)

phases.title: Mobile: Critical Interactions
phases.objective: Replicate high-risk/critical checks in mobile viewport (360x640) to validate responsive UX and tap targets.
key_checks: Test small tap targets (top nav links, sidebar buttons) in mobile → check tapability
Verify responsive layout (cards, modals) adapt to mobile
exit_criteria: Small tap target usability in mobile confirmed/flagged

phases.title: High-Risk Actions (Delete/Export)
phases.objective: Deep-validate high-risk actions (delete account, export) with double-confirmation flows and error recovery.
key_checks: Cancel 'Delete account' → check recovery (no data loss)
Initiate 'Export data' → verify progress/modal, then cancel

phases.title: Usability Critique (All Views)
phases.objective: Critique overall UX (information hierarchy, error states, accessibility) for the single-page dashboard.
key_checks: Check error states (e.g., failed export, invalid toggle) → are they clear?
Verify accessibility (contrast, screen-reader labels) → prescan hints at buttons/links
Evaluate information hierarchy (cards, sections) → is critical info (privacy score, controls) prominent?
exit_criteria: UX critique (accessibility, hierarchy, error states) documented

coverage_targets.features: ≥80% of visible controls (toggles, modals, buttons) exercised
coverage_targets.mobile: 100% of critical actions (delete, export, small taps) rechecked

notes: Prescan shows 125 buttons/34 inputs → focus on high-impact controls (delete, export, toggles) first.
Small tap targets (≤44px height) identified in top nav/sidebar → test for mobile usability.
